body: ACCEPT. The explicit B0-A-source -> B0-A edge is required: without it, the wrapper could satisfy its row-accounting contract while aggregate B0 closes before the required favorable source decision. Keeping the source gate transitive through B0-A is the smallest executable topology and preserves bead-granular readiness. The listed non-closing outcomes remain non-closing; an optional NotSelected/Excluded disposition cannot substitute for the required source branch. No reverse edge or authority expansion is implied.
